title: kith-jmap: add axum and tokio deps to Cargo.toml
description:
Add axum.workspace = true and tokio.workspace = true to crates/kith-jmap/Cargo.toml. Without these, no handler code in kith-jmap will compile.

What: Add two lines to kith-jmap/Cargo.toml.

Algorithm:
1. Open crates/kith-jmap/Cargo.toml.
2. Under [dependencies], add: axum.workspace = true
3. Add: tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["rt"] }
4. Run cargo check -p kith-jmap to verify compilation.

Defensive programming rules:
- No other changes.
- Do not add tokio/full — only rt is needed for this crate.
- Verify the workspace Cargo.toml already declares axum and tokio.

Tests: cargo check -p kith-jmap passes clean after the change.
